body.title: INI-01 Pass redesign + digital activation: initiative business case (synthetic)

sections.strategicRationale: Low activation -> Proposition + journey -> attach rate / activation (B0147). Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.baselineSummary: May 2026 baseline: attach rate 18 % of 220,000 travelling customers per month. Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.interventionsSummary: Roaming pass architecture redesign and one-tap digital activation in the app.
sections.investmentSummary: Cash: capex 2,400,000 SAR for the digital roaming activation platform.
sections.benefitsSummary: Revenue uplift 7,128,000 SAR at the annual run-rate at target (formula BF-01).
sections.benefitRamp: Monthly ramp from July 2026 to the December 2026 targets.
sections.recurrenceSummary: Recurring benefit; the investment is approved once.
sections.decisionAskText: Fund INI-01: Cash: capex 2,400,000 SAR for the digital roaming activation platform. (synthetic demonstration).
